subject: Beyond just notetaking - ML pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the Crunchbase piece on Otter and [SENDER] 's push beyond notetaking,
which is an exciting direction given the demands on your multimodal and
audio models.

We've been supporting teams like Thinking Machines, Synthesia and Captions
with multichannel audio pipelines (speaker turns/overlaps, acoustic event
labelling, confirmation/rejection loops, etc.) through Encord.

Our multimodal ML DataOps platform supports native curation (embedding
search) and automated annotation using your own models.

Would you be open to a quick 15/20 min call to see if any of this could
help your roadmap? I'm free Wednesday or Friday morning, or Thursday
afternoon if that works?
